Getting to know the past, stories, and alleged paranormal activities related to a place may help one gain a deeper understanding.Ghost tourism has become an interesting niche in the tourism sector, appealing to people who seek something other than just sightseeing. This type of tourism requires visiting locations associated with death, tragedy, ghosts or any form of mysterious stories. To some tourists, the attraction is about the excitement, while to others it is an opportunity to learn about the stories that have made the location mysterious.

What is ghost tourism and why is it becoming more popular?

Ghost tourism can be traced way back into history. Stories about ghosts and hauntings were told by ancient civilisations and through local folklore. The commercial version emerged in the latter part of the 20th century, especially with the emergence of ghost tours.

Cities like London and Edinburgh made this experience popular. Tourists would be taken through historic areas of cities while their guides narrated horrifying stories relating to castles, prisons, burial grounds and similar places.

What places are included in ghost tourism?

Haunted houses are the most well-known destinations. Many privately owned buildings and historical buildings are considered to have been haunted by spirits. Visitors can take guided tours or, in some cases, even stay overnight.

Ghost tourism turns haunted locations into immersive history experiences

Cemeteries provide an alternative adventure. Travellers get to visit cemeteries, learn about history, and pay their respects to prominent personalities at their place of final rest.

There are also abandoned places that lure in adventurers. Abandoned buildings, ghost towns, and asylum buildings provide an eerie backdrop to their tales.

Abandoned asylums and ghost towns add mystery to the travel experience

The battlefield is yet another type of heritage site to consider. The visitor comes here in order to learn about the battles fought in the past in relation to the haunting phenomenon surrounding this site.

How can travellers prepare for ghost tourism?

Research is an effective starting point. Getting to know the past, stories, and alleged paranormal activities related to a place may help one gain a deeper understanding.

Local beliefs about death and the afterlife can shape the visitor experience

Travelling with friends or as part of a guided tour is another way to ensure one's safety in unknown places. Depending on the destination, travellers may also require flashlights and cameras.
